page: Microsoft Azure NV6ads_A10_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the NVADSA10v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 6 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 55.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 9.17 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes a fractional GPU allocation, specifically 0.1667 of an NVIDIA A10 GPU, which provides 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the instance is bundled with a 184 GB local SSD. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage for external disk requirements. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

The fractional GPU allocation offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full, dedicated GPU card, optimizing resource density. However, the fractional nature of the GPU and the lack of public IPv4 addresses are key tradeoffs to consider. This hardware profile is suited for entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks, virtual desktops, light 3D rendering, and workloads requiring a moderate balance of memory and compute.
